summary:
Implementation Plan v4 — Full-Corpus NAVAREA Warning Plotting System.
Incorporates:
- Generalization discipline with a frozen 15% held-out slice and explicit failure triage protocol (new pattern vs accepted noise).
- Deterministic lifecycle resolution chain with timestamp-based contradiction resolution and explicit CANCEL precedence over earlier lists.
- Partial and truncated in-force list handling (fixture IX 529/24) with visible UI badges and prefix-scoped oracle assertions.
- Keyword classification hygiene rules (strict boundaries, DEMOLITION ordnance co-occurrence, MINE critical mapping) and 8-fixture adversarial test suite.
- Reinstated binding acceptance criteria tables: 17-pattern golden fixture suite, 5,000-warning performance budgets, and comprehensive risk/mitigation register.
- M3 Lifecycle effort marked as L, and visual design note detailing the hazardIcons.ts SVG registry.
